# Live Orbit

Live Orbit is a satellite tracking app for iOS and iPadOS from Apps Made Better LLC, an independent app publisher based in Texas. Founder Samuele Marcucci lives in New York City.

Explore calculated satellite positions on a 3D globe, search by name or NORAD ID, plan visible passes, and use Sky Mode and AR guidance. Time Mode explores calculated positions up to a week backward or forward. Available SatNOGS recordings are playback of ground-station observations, not direct satellite reception by an iPhone or iPad.

Free to download with in-app purchases. Some features require Live Orbit Pro. No Live Orbit account is required. The App Store listing and the in-app purchase screen are authoritative for current compatibility, availability, and pricing. Satellite positions, passes, and pointing are estimates.
